title: Uruguayan Cabbage Stew
description: A hearty and comforting stew from Uruguay made with tender cabbage and nourishing beef.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add beef and cook until browned, about 5 minutes. Remove from pot and set aside.
Add onion and garlic to pot and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add cabbage, tomato paste, stew seasoning, salt, and pepper. Cook for 1 minute.
Add red wine and bring to a boil.
Return beef to pot and stir to coat with wine mixture.
Cover pot and transfer to oven. Braise for 2 1/2 hours, or until beef is tender.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley.
